name: Balbach Teaching Dimension of Warmuth's $C_5$ Class
proof: For Warmuth's $C_5$ class, ordinary teaching dimension and recursive teaching dimension are both three. The established sandwich $\mathrm{TD}\ge\mathrm{BTD}\ge\mathrm{RTD}$ therefore forces $\mathrm{BTD}=3$.
references: \cite{zilles2011models,balbach2008measuring,palvolgyi2021unlabeled}; derived using established TD and RTD values
